findings.issue_signature: AlertRulesHealthIndicator always returns UP — degraded flag hardcoded to false, threshold breach detection is a no-op
findings.title: Health indicator does not detect threshold breaches
findings.evidence_before: Line 99: `boolean degraded = false;` — never set to true. Lines 101-115: threshold values are read and added as details but `degraded` is never toggled. Line 119: `return builder.status(degraded ? "DEGRADED" : "UP").build();` — always returns "UP".
findings.fix_recommendation: Add threshold comparison logic inside the HealthIndicator lambda: query actual values via MeterRegistry or MetricsConfig.syncQueueDepthHolder, compare against thresholds, set degraded=true when breached.
findings.blocking_validation: A synthetic health check that always returns UP provides no operational value and will mislead monitoring/alerting.
findings.success_condition: AlertRulesHealthIndicator returns DOWN or DEGRADED when any critical threshold is breached at check time

findings.issue_signature: AuditAspect.extractCorrelationId() silently returns null with no logging when MDC.get('correlationId') throws
findings.title: Correlation ID silently lost in AuditAspect when MDC access fails
findings.evidence_before: Lines 96-104: try { return org.slf4j.MDC.get("correlationId"); } catch (Exception e) { return null; } — if MDC.get() throws any exception (e.g., IllegalArgumentException from a malformed key), it is silently swallowed and null is returned. No log.warn() or log.debug() call. The audit entry will have null correlation_id with no indication that extraction failed.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add a log.warn() or log.debug() in the catch block documenting the failure. Alternatively, check MDC.getCopyOfContextMap() != null before calling MDC.get() and log at DEBUG level if context is absent (expected in some unit test scenarios).
findings.blocking_validation: MEDIUM — correlation ID may be silently lost in edge-case scenarios, breaking traceability between audit entries and request logs. However, the primary path (normal MDC access) works correctly.
findings.success_condition: AuditAspect logs a warning when correlation ID cannot be extracted, rather than silently returning null

summary.OBS-1: Core observability infrastructure is well-implemented (JSON logging, metrics, tracing, alerting config) but AlertRulesHealthIndicator is a no-op — it never sets degraded=true regardless of threshold values
summary.OBS-2: Security baseline is fully implemented — TLS env-only secrets, OWASP scanning, encrypted backups, backup retention policy, encryption policy. Minor note: docker-compose hardcoded dev password is acceptable for local dev only
summary.OBS-3: Audit infrastructure is comprehensive and well-designed (async non-blocking writes, MDC propagation, transactional, failure-isolated). One issue: AuditAspect.extractCorrelationId() silently swallows exceptions when MDC access fails
